QUICK START GUIDE
CREATE METAMASK WALLETCREATE METAMASK WALLET

Create a MetaMask Wallet using either a desktop computer or an iOS or Android mobile device. That will allow you to buy, sell, send, and receive OMIKAMI.

send ETH to your walletsend ETH to your wallet

Before purchasing OMIKAMI, you need to add Ethereum (ETH) to your MetaMask Wallet. ETH can be purchased directly within MetaMask or transferred from exchanges like Coinbase or Binance using the ERC-20 network. This ETH will be used to trade for OMIKAMI.

CONNECT WALLET TO UNISWAPCONNECT WALLET TO UNISWAP

Access your wallet from Uniswap by clicking ‘Connect to a wallet’ and selecting MetaMask.

SWAP ETH FOR OMIKAMISWAP ETH FOR OMIKAMI

You can start swapping as soon as you have ETH available! Press ‘Select a token’ and enter the token address or search for it on the token list.

HOW TO BUY

OMIKAMI is best purchased and sold through Uniswap, or at future CEXs listings.

OMIKAMI is a decentralized experiment, and, as such, we always incentivize the use of DEXs. If you choose to utilize a future CEX instead, remember to research it first to ensure it is both safe and secure.
